description: On the tabletop there’s a colorful structure of large soft Lego-style blocks, along with several loose blocks scattered nearby. The left hand comes in to steady and lift a stacked blue-and-yellow section while the right hand moves in from the right to pick up and slide other blocks away, causing the larger build to break apart into separate pieces; both hands then hold and reposition different blocks, releasing them into a loose pile as the structure is disassembled.
